# Open decisions index

Every open decision, TODO, to-verify item and deliberately-deferred gap recorded
in `docs/` and in the harvested test corpora, filed as a GitHub issue so that
nothing lives only inside a document. Generated by a one-off harvest of
`docs/spec/*.md` §12, `docs/inventory/*.md` "Open questions",
`docs/decisions/*.md` consequences, `docs/kernel-requirements.md` §6,
`docs/test-port-plan.md` §6 and `tests/bpf/CASES.toml`.

Items recorded in more than one document are filed once, with every source
named in the issue body.

**Do not edit by hand while the harvest is running.**
